channels.description: THEN channels — which delivery methods to use

conditions.description: IF conditions — array of {field, operator, value} objects, ALL must pass (AND logic)

cooldown_seconds.description: Minimum seconds between duplicate fires of this rule for the same event (dedup/throttle)

event_name.description: Trigger event key (e.g. driver_completed, driver_failed, app_update_available)

priority.description: Evaluation order — lower number = evaluated first

recipients.description: THEN recipients — who gets the message

shadow_mode.description: If true, log what would be sent but don't actually send

stop_on_match.description: If true, stop evaluating further rules for this event once this one fires
